notes.title: FPS Multiplayer
notes.notes: [p]FPS Multiplayer Playtest has been started.[/p][p]The playtest will initially run for 4 weeks[/p][p]Dedicated servers are not yet available, but are in progress.[/p][p]Therefore players have to create a game with up to 32 players themselves.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy the playtest.[/p]
